name: solidity-queued-restaking-vault
title: Slashable queued staking vault
description: ERC20 staking shares with delayed withdrawal requests, pro-rata losses and bounded admin slashing.
assumptions: Centralized slash authority with a per-call rate ceiling; repeated slashes can remove most assets. Shares in the exit queue remain slashable until completion. No actual restaking service, evidence verification or operator registry. Virtual share offset reduces donation manipulation.
